Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-end architectural concept exterior for a Minecraft Create / Copycat Architect building redesign, single landscape image.
Input image: historical industrial Minecraft complex, use it as architectural reference, preserve recognisable massing and identity, but redesign with finer sub-block geometry.
Primary request: a substantially more refined version of this exact ensemble "Quartier de l'Horloge", not a new generic city. Left: a compact two-storey red brick industrial restaurant hall, about 17 blocks wide and 23 blocks deep, with tall slender dark iron-framed arched windows, continuous pale limestone string courses and projecting profiled cornices. The hall has a distinctive steep dark slate gambrel roof with subtly curved eaves, crisp fine planes instead of Minecraft stairs, a high large arched front gable window and two slim brick chimneys. Right, beside the front of the hall: a narrow square clock tower about 7 blocks wide rising about 36 blocks, finely moulded warm grey masonry base, dark oak vertical framing with restrained brass detailing, a large circular ivory and brass clock face genuinely circular and recessed, slender shaft windows, pointed reddish copper roof with crisp sloping faces. Behind: two smaller brick houses and a small sheltered cobbled courtyard with arcaded passage and planting. Keep the complex small and plausible.
Main design improvement: 1/16 block detail, true slender profiles, subtle beveled stone piers, smooth round arches and circular clock, elegant roof transitions, legible structural hierarchy. Retain block scale and lightly pixelated Minecraft material textures, this is sophisticated Create-mod architecture with custom shapes, not a photoreal real-world building. Finely detailed, not noisy or overdecorated.
Composition: front three-quarter view from street eye level slightly raised, show the entire clock tower including tip with comfortable margins, hall on the left and tower on the right; a glimpse of courtyard behind. Broad 16:10 or 3:2 landscape framing. Brick, pale grey stone, dark iron, warm dark wood, dark slate and aged copper palette. Soft warm afternoon, clear sky, subtle ambient shadows, dignified architectural render, coherent real scale.
Ground: restrained cobbled apron and grass, softly blocky river-valley background inspired by reference, let architecture dominate.
Constraints: no people, no lettering, no watermark, no UI, no floating forms, no fantastical city, no giant palace, no extra clock towers, no timber medieval fantasy ornament. This is a concept visualization of the improved design, not a screenshot of an actual built game world.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised architectural concept interior of the same industrial restaurant.
Primary request: revise this interior to the FINAL spatial design: add an open central double-height hall with an upper gallery, preserving the material palette, arched windows, furniture character and camera direction of the reference.
Geometry: hall clear interior 15 blocks wide and23 deep. At the first-floor slab 6 blocks above ground, a central slot 5 blocks wide and17 long remains OPEN. This leaves 5-block-wide upper side galleries on left and right, joined by a 3-block-deep upper walkway across the far end and another at the entrance. The U-shaped rear right stair connects up to the right gallery. Remove the existing low central ceiling along the middle third of the image so we can see the 11-block-high central volume and dark timber roof structure at the top. The resulting space has intimate dining under the gallery on each side and a taller central aisle; it does not become a vast cathedral.
Keep brick piers, pale dressed stone, dark iron with subtle brass, sunlight, tables and green banquettes. Keep camera near front entrance facing the back bar and stair, broad architectural landscape perspective. Lightly pixelated Minecraft textures and bespoke Copycat Architect fine profiles. Clean coherent engineering, warm daylight reaching the ground floor through the two tiers of windows.
Constraints: preserve a legible useable central aisle and realistic restaurant scale; every visible gallery edge needs a railing; rear stair connects to an actual walkway; no text, no people, no UI, no watermark. This is a proposed interior fit-out concept.
outputs.basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: architectural interior concept for "Quartier de l'Horloge" restaurant, one large landscape image.
Input image: approved exterior concept for palette, architectural identity, window profiles and material vocabulary. Show the interior belonging to the LEFT two-storey red brick restaurant hall in this reference. This is an interior design proposal, not an existing game screenshot.
Space: ground floor dining hall approx 15 Minecraft blocks clear width, 23 deep, 5 high; upper floor is a separate enclosed dining level above a full timber ceiling. Do NOT show a mezzanine, atrium, double-height void or roof here. High arched iron-framed windows on the two long walls, large clear panes with thin sub-block frames; pale stone window reveals, brick piers with refined pale stone string courses, dark timber ceiling beams at 5m, restrained iron braces and warm brass pendants.
Layout: welcoming central aisle from the front entry, a row of timber bistro tables each side, cozy dark green banquettes at the brick piers, a compact oak and brass bar towards the back left with kitchen/service doorway behind, and an honest visible OPEN U-shaped staircase at the back right leading up through an appropriately sized ceiling opening. Keep sensible walking routes, tables at human scale. Right rear staircase has two flights with intermediate landing, fine dark metal balustrade. No people.
Camera: eye-height broad 24–28mm architectural perspective from just inside front entrance down the long room; show windows, dining tables, bar and staircase clearly. Brick, pale limestone, dark iron and warm oak match exterior. Lightly pixelated Minecraft material surfaces with bespoke fine geometry of Copycat Architect, polished architectural game concept render. Comfortable afternoon sunlight through the tall side windows and warm practical lights, balanced exposure, no fisheye.
Constraints: one image, no collage, no text, no watermark, no UI, no fantasy gears all over the walls, no contemporary glass skyscraper finishes. Retain the industrial café identity of the provided exterior. Furniture is a proposal for fit-out, building geometry must remain plausible at the stated scale.
